chunks: Al-Hakim Abu Ali Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Bayhaqi narrated to us, saying: He narrated to me Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sawli, saying: He narrated to us Abu Thakwan, saying: I heard Ibrahim ibn Al-Abbas say:

The pledge of allegiance to Ar-Ridha (peace be upon him) was on the fifth day remaining of the month of Ramadhan in the year 201 A.H. He was married to his daughter Umm Habib at the beginning of the year 202 A.H. He died in the year 203 A.H. in Toos, while Al-Ma'mun was heading to Iraq in the month of Rajab. And someone other than him narrated to me that Ar-Ridha (peace be upon him) died when he was forty-nine and a half years old. The correct information is that he died in the month of Ramadhan, nine days remaining from it, on a Friday, in the year 203 A.H. from the migration of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Ar-Ridha (a title of Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha)
key_terms.رَجَبٍ: Rajab (the seventh month of the Islamic calendar)
key_terms.هِجْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ: The migration of the Prophet (Hijri calendar reference)

ai.seo_question: When and where did Imam Ar-Ridha (a.s.) die according to Shia historical sources?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* establishes the precise chronology of Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida’s (a.s.) political elevation and martyrdom under the Abbasid Caliph Al-Ma'mun, highlighting the marriage alliance as a key element of the 'Tahkim' (acceptance of governorship). It resolves historical discrepancies regarding his age and confirms his death in the last ten days of Ramadan, 203 A.H., in Toos, reinforcing the Shia tradition of his burial there. This timeline is crucial for understanding the transition from the Imam's quietist period to his eventual martyrdom, which is often linked to the political instability of the late 9th century.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 63-2 Al-Hakim Abu Ali Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Bayhaqi narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sowli quoted on the authority of Abu Thakwan that he had heard Ibrahim ibn Al-Abbas say,

“The pledge of allegiance to Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) occurred on the fifth day of the (Arabic) month of Ramadhan in the year 201 A.H. (815 A.D.). Al-Ma’mun married off his own younger daughter - Umm Habib - to Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) at the beginning of the year 202 A.H. (816 A.D.). He died in Toos in the year 203 A.H. (817 A.D.), while Al-Ma’mun was going to Iraq in the (Arabic) month of Rajab.”And someone other than Al-Bayhaqi narrated that Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) died when he (a.s.) was forty-nine and a half years old. The correct information is that he died in the year 203 A.H. (817 A.D.) on a Friday during the last ten days of the (Arabic) month of Ramadhan - nine days before the end of the month.
